stack_rankings.stack: LAR QB + Puka Nacua + Davante Adams, Josh Allen runback
stack_rankings.why: Highest total (54.5) paired with the closest spread among elites (-3.5). Both teams throw all game; no blowout script. The mass optimizer's value model underweights this because LAR/BUF salaries are efficient — that's the edge.

stack_rankings.stack: Jared Goff + Amon-Ra St. Brown + Jameson Williams, Marvin Harrison Jr. runback ($4.4K)
stack_rankings.why: Co-highest total in a dome. DET team total 30.0 is the slate's highest. MHJ at $4,400 is the best runback value on the slate if the ARI pass game shows up. Spread (-5.5) is the only knock — DET could salt it away.

stack_rankings.stack: Joe Burrow + Ja'Marr Chase + Tee Higgins, Ollie Gordon II runback
stack_rankings.why: Best pure QB-WR1-WR2 trio on the slate; 55% of the mass optimizer's top-100 lineups stack CIN. BUT: MIA is decimated (no Hill, Waddle on DEN, Achane $4K) so the runback is thin, and -7 spread is blowout risk. JEV sims killed the CIN build head-to-head (tourney 149 vs 195) — too expensive, not enough around it.

stack_rankings.stack: SEA QB + Jaxon Smith-Njigba (+ Noah Fant-style value), CMC/Kittle runback
stack_rankings.why: Third-highest total with a competitive spread. JSN is the slate's highest-ceiling WR (50.2) at GSE 100. This is the stack the JEV winner actually plays — validated, not theoretical.

stack_rankings.stack: Drake Maye + Stefon Diggs, Brock Bowers runback
stack_rankings.why: Co-third total, close spread. Bowers (GSE 100, 41.0 ceiling) is the slate's positional slate-breaker at TE. NE -3.5 keeps both teams in pass script.

prop_edges.angle: DET team total OVER — 30.0 derived vs dome + ARSB/Gibbs form
prop_edges.edge: Highest derived team total on slate; dome removes weather variance

prop_edges.angle: BUF@LAR game total OVER 54.5 alt lines
prop_edges.edge: Two top-8 offenses, close spread, no weather; first-score-TD rate 58-63% favors early points
GSE 100 TE, 41.0 ceiling; TEs who outscore WR1s decide GPPs; NE funnel defense vs TEs
50.2 ceiling is slate-best; SF@SEA 45.5 total with competitive script

prop_edges.angle: Brandon Aubrey / elite kickers OVER kicking points
prop_edges.edge: FG model: dome + high-total games = more drives stalling in FG range (edge #3)
London game not on slate — zero exposure, don't get cute

contrarian_angles.leverage: 1.7% ownership proxy; minimum-salary QB unlocks four GSE 99-100 pass-catchers. If SEA throws 40+ times vs SF, the salary relief wins the slate.
Punt TE in a dome game stack (MIN@NO); 17.4 ceiling at 21% proxy ownership. FLEX punt + studs is the classic 50-man winner shape.
7.9% proxy ownership; cheapest viable DST (9.5 fppg) paired with Bowers for LV game-script leverage.
The field will flock to the highest total. #5 fades it entirely — differentiation if that game disappoints, and the JEV sims say the SEA/MIN/NO/LV construction outscores it anyway.
GSE 86 at minimum RB salary vs NO; second salary-saver that funds the stars.

final_lineup.selection: JEV lineup #5 — rank 1 of 20 by tourney_score

head_to_head.challenger: Best CIN double-stack build (Burrow+Chase+Higgins+Gordon runback) — the mass optimizer's favorite archetype
head_to_head.verdict: #5 wins every metric: tourney 195.4 vs 149.2, p99 240.8 vs 185.9. The CIN triple costs $22,100 and MIA's runback is decimated (no Hill, Waddle on DEN) — not enough value around it. Engine overrules the mass optimizer's salary-derived signal.

final_lineup.stack: SEA Lock + JSN (2-man QB stack) | MIN@NO game stack (Mason vs Olave+Fant NO double) | LV Bowers + Raiders DST pair | HOU Collins standalone

players.name: Drew Lock
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: SF@SEA (45.5, 3rd-highest total, -3.0 competitive). WHY THIS STACK: minimum-salary QB paired with the slate's best WR. WHY THIS PLAYER: $4,000 salary relief funds three GSE 99-100 pass-catchers; 27.4 ceiling at 1.7% ownership proxy is the slate's best leverage point.

players.name: Jordan Mason
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: MIN@NO dome (41.5). WHY THIS PLAYER: $4,000 minimum salary, GSE 86; second salary-saver. Dome + home run game = touchdown equity.

players.name: Kyle Monangai
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: CHI@GB (46.5 total — sneaky shootout). WHY THIS PLAYER: GSE 95 at $5,200 with 16.3 fppg — best points-per-dollar RB on the slate; lead-back volume in a high-total game.

players.name: Jaxon Smith-Njigba
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: same SF@SEA shootout pocket. WHY THIS STACK: primary QB stack piece — correlated spike weeks. WHY THIS PLAYER: 50.2 ceiling is #1 on the slate, GSE 100. Alpha WR1s win 50-mans.

players.name: Nico Collins
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: HOU@TEN — HOU -7 means positive script all game. WHY THIS PLAYER: GSE 99, 44.0 ceiling vs TEN. Standalone alpha; doesn't need a stack to spike.

players.name: Chris Olave
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: MIN@NO dome — NO side of the game stack. WHY THIS STACK: paired with Fant for double NO exposure against MIN. WHY THIS PLAYER: GSE 99, 39.7 ceiling in a dome.

players.name: Brock Bowers
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: LV@NE (45.5). WHY THIS PLAYER: GSE 100 TE with 41.0 ceiling — the positional slate-breaker. TEs who outscore WR1s decide GPPs, and Bowers has the best TE ceiling on the slate.

players.name: Noah Fant
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: MIN@NO dome — second NO piece. WHY THIS STACK: completes the NO double with Olave for correlated dome exposure. WHY THIS PLAYER: $3,000 punt at FLEX unlocks the stars; 17.4 ceiling at 21% proxy ownership.

players.name: Raiders
players.reasoning: WHY THIS GAME: LV@NE. WHY THIS STACK: paired with Bowers — if LV controls the game, both hit. WHY THIS PLAYER: $2,500 minimum DST (9.5 fppg) at 7.9% ownership; cheapest viable defense funds the skill ceiling.

jev.verdict_source: relative-heuristic-from-sim-metrics (dup_risk quartile within this set); live JEV API (jev ask) not reachable from this host

engine_conclusion: The engine ran the full slate: 13 games priced via the Laplace margin layer, 100,000 lineups mined for stack signal (CIN dominates the crude model), then JEV 10,000-sim arbitration on the finalists. The mass optimizer loved CIN; the JEV sims killed it — too expensive, no runback. Lineup #5 (SEA/MIN/NO/LV/HOU) wins every JEV metric and is the single entry. Tourney 190.2, p99 232.6, CERTIFIED.
